extraction_notes: Lung’Ie entries are isolated from the comparative seed and its named sources. No Forro or Angolar headword was copied into this folder. Additional verified items were added from Maurer 2013 APiCS survey chapters and from Angolar/Lung’Ie-labelled lines in Rougé and Schang 2012. Portuguese is null when the source only gives an English (or French) gloss. No Forro headword was copied into this folder. Further items were added from open academic web sources (USP thesis; SciELO). Languages remain isolated. Portuguese is null when the source only gives English. Further Lung’Ie items were added from Agostinho & Araujo 2021 (Lung’Ie, lunge no glossary) and from open academic papers. Languages remain isolated. Further items were added from Bandeira 2017 Chapter 5 cognate tables, using only the language-specific column. Further labelled items were added from Bandeira, Agostinho & Freitas 2021 (Angolar running-text examples) and Bandeira & Araujo 2022 (language-isolated cells and examples). Portuguese remains null when a source does not print Portuguese.
